definition: Apache Airflow orchestrates scheduled or triggered workflows whose tasks and dependencies are defined as directed acyclic graphs.
entry_text: Apache Airflow orchestrates scheduled or triggered workflows whose tasks and dependencies are defined as directed acyclic graphs.
example: A data engineer makes a reporting task wait for two source extracts to complete.
label: Apache Airflow

sources.note: The project guide documents schedule, explicit and asset-triggered runs, and acyclic task dependencies. Airflow coordinates task execution rather than prescribing what happens inside each task.
